firstPlayerRule: The player who visited Spain most recently takes the First Player marker and plays the first Power card.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Power cards are played in clockwise order from the First Player marker; turns are then taken from the highest Power card down.
At the end of each round, whoever played the lowest Power card takes the First Player marker.
In the two-player game, the dummy never gets the First Player marker.

Page 4: the player with the First Player marker begins playing Power cards, then clockwise; turns follow from the highest Power card. Page 7: whoever played the lowest Power card takes the First Player marker. Page 9, two-player rules: the dummy never gets the First Player marker. uncertainty: The rulebook gives no tie-break if several players visited Spain equally recently or nobody has visited.
